mechanics.title: Armory proficiency and blueprint power tiers
mechanics.exactText:
1. Each Weapon model Blueprint offers a list of Proficiency Level Quests that can be completed by playing with a copy of that Weapon. 
2. Each Proficiency Level Quest you complete will reward 1 Armory Proficiency Level Point, which contributes to increasing the Armory Proficiency Level gauge. 
3. When you have enough Points, the Armory Proficiency Level will increase, rewarding you with permanent Attributes Bonuses that apply at all times to your character.
4. Armory Proficiency Level up also rewards you with the materials needed to perform a Weapon Power Tier Enhancement on Weapon Blueprints, allowing you to raise their Power Tier.

mechanics.title: Unlocked blueprint capabilities
mechanics.exactText: Once a Blueprint is unlocked, the depicted item can be crafted, tactically augmented, or improved in terms of Proficiency.

mechanics.title: Crafting proficiency and equipment quality
mechanics.exactText:
1. Each equipment craft has a chance to create equipment of varying qualities, including white, green, blue, purple, and gold.
2. The higher the crafting proficiency level, the greater the chance of crafting higher quality equipment.
3. Each crafting attempt increases the proficiency experience of the equipment. Once the experience reaches a certain value, the crafting proficiency will level up.

mechanics.title: Separate specialization and character XP
mechanics.exactText: Gain a specific Specialization's <color=#FF3600FF>Specialization XP</color> by playing as that Specialization. <color=#FF3600FF>Specialization XP</color> and <color=#FF3600FF>Character XP</color> are calculated independently. <color=#FF3600FF>Specialization XP</color> raises a Specialization's level, while <color=#FF3600FF>Character XP</color> raises a character's level.

mechanics.title: Armor weaknesses and damage types
mechanics.exactText: Some enemies possess Armor Weaknesses; use weapons with the appropriate Damage Types to effectively combat them. Keep in mind that their Armor Weaknesses will periodically refresh.
